title: Trace form
description: A captured form: its pages and elements, the fields found on it, the values dictated into them, hints, and what a person decided. Version 2b-0.1 (draft, 2026-10-07).

form.description: The form as a document, independent of this filling

language.description: language of the printed form; dictation is mapped into this language

origin.description: original: the published form unchanged; rebuilt: our own layout with the same fields

after.description: for a rebuilt form: the form it follows (name and publisher)

file.description: path of the PDF relative to the data folder

width.description: pixels at 300 dpi; every x, y, width, height below refers to this

unit.description: character height of the page in pixels, as measured

blocks.description: every element the geometry found, unchanged; fields point at them

fields.description: what can be filled in, in reading order

audio.description: the dictation, as recorded on the device

language.description: language spoken; may differ from form.language

pieces.description: number of pieces the recording was cut into at silence

transcript.description: what the model heard, piece by piece; raw and untouched

start.description: seconds from the start of the recording

text.description: transcript after number words were turned into digits

raw.description: transcript exactly as the model returned it

approve.description: a person should listen: the piece was empty, cut off, or the model switched language

status.description: where the form stands in the flow

history.description: what happened to this form, in order

block.description: one element of a page, as the geometry and the reading step produced it

id.description: b1, b2, … in reading order over the whole form

content.description: text read from the element; for checkbox and radio "x" when ticked, otherwise empty

isOCR.description: the content was read from the image, not taken from a text layer

approve.description: a person should look: the rendered text does not match the image

label.description: the printed label next to or above the field

labelBlock.description: id of the block that carries the label

boxBlock.description: id of the block that is the input, checkbox or radio

group.description: radios that exclude each other share a group name

option.description: for a radio or checkbox: what ticking it means, from its label

required.description: must carry a value before sending; from the catalogue

widget.description: name of the PDF form field this field writes into, when the PDF is fillable

value.description: what was dictated or entered; for checkbox and radio "x" or empty

source.description: where a value came from and whether a person should look at it

piece.description: transcript piece the value was taken from

quote.description: the words in the transcript the value rests on

how.description: literal: the value stands in the transcript as is; derived: every word of it does, in another order; cited: the model named the piece but the words are not there; composed: the model phrased it; entered: a person typed it

approve.description: a person should look: not literal or derived, or the piece carries approve

review.description: what a person did with the value

rule.description: id of a general rule, when the change came from one or founded one

hint.description: something a person should check before sending; the program never says "not allowed"

kind.description: missing: required field empty (code); vague: the model found the entry insufficient against the catalogue; legal: the catalogue's requirement for this field; format: the value does not fit the kind (code)

article.description: legal reference as printed in the catalogue, e.g. SchKG Art. 67 Abs. 1 Ziff. 3

catalogue.description: catalogue file and its validation stamp
